summary_md: **XiaoDong ([@haishenling](https://x.com/haishenling/status/2116438251519213735))** reports that Speridlabs open-sourced **Idol**, which turns a single photo into a 3D Gaussian splat in about two seconds on a consumer GPU with roughly 7.2 GB VRAM, with an online demo ([speridlabs/idol](https://huggingface.co/speridlabs/idol)).
relevance: Fast single-image to 3D for media pipelines.

media.description: Demo video of Idol converting a single image into a 3D Gaussian splat.
